final_claim: For finite nonempty equivalence relations \(A,B\), rank-\(q\) first-order equivalence is exactly characterized by equality of the triangular truncations \(\min(N_k,q-k+1)\) for \(1\le k\le q\) and \(\min(C_k,q-k)\) for \(1\le k<q\), where \(N_k\) counts classes of size at least \(k\) and \(C_k\) counts classes of size exactly \(k\).
